# Privacy Requirements Quality Checklist: Wayfinder self-assessment

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements for the URL fragment, analytics and no-storage guarantees are complete, consistent and testable.
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by /speckit-checklist. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Data Flow

- [x] CHK018 Is "nothing stored" defined for every browser mechanism (cookies, local/session storage, IndexedDB, cache, history state), not just examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK019 Is the one deliberate persistence (the address-bar fragment) reconciled with the "stores nothing" claim in the issue and spec wording? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements stated for what the fragment contains, and is it required to hold nothing beyond five scores, date and version? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, contracts/results-link.md]
- [x] CHK021 Is it specified that history is replaced rather than added, so earlier results are not left in history entries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the results link being shared, bookmarked, or pasted into a message (who can read it, reader warned)? [Gap]

## Analytics and Network

- [x] CHK023 Is "no analytics event for them" extended to the edge-injected beacon recording page URL or fragment, and is the requirement independent of the unresolved research R14 finding? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016, plan Risks]
- [x] CHK024 Is a failure condition defined if the beacon is found to record the fragment (who decides, what changes, deadline)? [Gap, plan Risks]
- [x] CHK025 Is SC-004 ("zero requests carrying answers or results") precise about request kinds covered (fetch, beacon, image, referrer, link prefetch)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK026 Are Referer/outbound-link requirements stated for the post's links when the page URL carries a fragment? [Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Is the statement that answers are not personal data supported by an assumption that the results link is never submitted to the contact form or an API? [Assumption, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK028 Does the privacy policy need an update, and is that decision recorded either way? [Gap, constitution VII]
- [x] CHK029 Are clearing requirements (answers, loaded result, fragment) complete for the copied link already on the clipboard and for the printed plan that includes the link? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §FR-010]
